_comment: triage-v4 deterministic classification rules. Stdlib-only classifier: tools/triage/classify.py. Category rule order is load-bearing (first match wins); priority and evidence are computed independently per spec. v4 = v3 with one third-party-name fix (GetTickCount_0 suffixed-Win32 rescue) plus documentation corrections; classifier logic change is confined to third_party_global_regexes: (a) Itanium-mangled game-class symbols (_ZN<Editor|UI>...) are exempt from the ^_Z third-party bucket and classified from their demangled scope; (b) SDK CONFIRMED game-namespace virtuals (sdk + vtable slot) classify as GAMEPLAY (SUPPORT for singleton Get/Set/Property, else LOGIC) instead of falling into the generic vtable-slot ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION bucket. Deliberately unchanged: P3 sdk+decomp rows without vtable stay P3 (no new structural evidence; bumping them would mint 315 recon candidates on name evidence alone), the 5755 FUN_ vtable-only pool stays ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION/P1 (no SDK/xref signal to attribute them), RenderWare/DirectX/CRT stay ENGINE_IMPL/THIRD_PARTY. Subsystem map: unchanged from v2.

notes.category_order: 1) thunk/external/non-.text/third-party-name (Itanium symbols whose outermost class is in itanium_game_classes are exempt from the ^_Z hit) -> THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME; 2) sdk top-namespace in engine_namespaces -> ENGINE_INTERFACE; 3) sdk top-namespace in game_namespaces AND vtable-slot member -> GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT (singleton Get/Set/Property pattern) else GAMEPLAY_LOGIC [v3 game-virtual rescue]; 4) vtable-slot member -> ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION; 5) singleton Get/Set/Property pattern -> GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT; 6) named in game namespaces (or game-global prefix; demangled scope used for Itanium-exempt rows) -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC; 7) else UNKNOWN.
notes.priority: Unchanged from v2: IGNORE=thunk/external/non-.text; P0=sdk AND vtable AND decomp; P1=sdk XOR (vtable OR decomp); P2=named non-sdk in game namespaces/globals; P3=everything else resident in .text (incl. FUN_ and CRT leftovers). In practice every sdk row also has decomp, so P1 = vtable-only SDK-less virtuals and sdk+decomp-without-vtable rows stay P3 by rule-order, not by oversight.
notes.evidence: Unchanged from v2: sdk_name -> CONFIRMED; named non-sdk (ghidra analysis, incl. demangled Itanium-exempt rows) -> SUPPORTED; FUN_ with vtable slot or heuristic subsystem -> INFERRED; else UNKNOWN. Never OBSERVED/VERIFIED without trace_run/test_result.
notes.struct_assoc: Best-effort: SDK class prefix matched against normalized struct names; may be empty. caller_count/callee_count are always NULL (no xref export); never zero-filled.
notes.v2_to_v3: (a) _ZN6EditorC2Ev (Editor::Editor, .text ctor, size 2149) and _ZN2UI6WindowC2Ev (UI::Window::Window, .text ctor, size 182), verified with c++filt, move THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME/P3 -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC/P2 via itanium_game_classes exemption. All other _Z symbols stay third-party. (b) 34 SDK CONFIRMED game-namespace virtuals (sdk+vtable+decomp, still P0) move ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION -> GAMEPLAY_LOGIC (26) / GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT (8: SetColor, GetCategory, GetAssetID, GetAuthorName, GetAuthorID, GetTags, GetTimeCreated, GetSimDataRTT). Recon candidates unchanged at 159. (c) considered and rejected: 315 sdk+decomp-no-vtable rows stay P3 (name+decomp without a structural slot link is not promotion evidence; moving them would mint recon candidates on name evidence alone). 5755 FUN_ vtable-only rows stay ENGINE_IMPLEMENTATION/P1 (no SDK/xref signal attributes them to game classes).
notes.known_gaps: Clock (4 SDK fns) and LocalizedString (2) have zero triage rows (VAs not function entries); caller_count/callee_count NULL everywhere (no xref export); 1186 SDK VAs with no function entry need function-boundary repair; 1-address sdk/decomp gap (478 manifest vs 477 rows); GalaxyGameEntry (2 SDK fns) unassigned; audio-havok-input KG node Havok hypothesis unverified.
notes.v3_to_v4: GetTickCount_0 @011ec830 (.text, non-thunk, Ghidra-discovered _0-suffixed duplicate of the Win32 GetTickCount import) moves GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT/P3/SUPPORTED -> THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME/P3/SUPPORTED via widened Win32 regex ^(GetTickCount|VerQueryValue|GetProcAddress|LoadLibrary|FreeLibrary)(_\d+|[AW])?$: exact-$ anchors missed _0 numeric suffixes and A/W ANSI/Unicode variants (VerQueryValueA/W were only caught as thunks). Evidence stays SUPPORTED (named non-thunk row); subsystem Unknown -> Runtime; by_category GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT 76->75, THIRD_PARTY_OR_RUNTIME 3563->3564; by_evidence/by_priority/recon/closure unchanged (58757). unknown-fun-mass cluster: UNKNOWN 48940->48941, GAMEPLAY_SUPPORT 2->1.
notes.sdk_confirmed_provenance: EXCEPTION (documented, adversarial-review item 6): sdk_name comes from the community Spore-ModAPI SDK (reverse-engineered headers, SDKtoGhidra/SporeGhidra_march2017.xml), not from EA source. CONFIRMED here means name-level provenance only (VA pinned to an SDK symbol + applied by the defensive ImportSporeSDK pass), NOT observed runtime behavior. Semantics stay capped: never OBSERVED/VERIFIED without trace_run/test_result; P0 additionally requires structural links (vtable slot + decomp file), so no reconstruction target rests on name evidence alone.
notes.unknown_supported_wrinkle: 30 UNKNOWN-category/SUPPORTED-evidence rows: named non-thunk .text functions matching no category rule (resident code, Ghidra-named, no SDK/vtable/game-ns signal). SUPPORTED records naming provenance only; category UNKNOWN records no gameplay/engine attribution. Deliberately retained (not demoted): demoting on zero evidence would destroy the naming signal; promoting would mint gameplay claims without structural links.
notes.sdk_duplicate_va: sdk_functions.tsv contains three duplicate VAs (verified by the loader, deterministic last-wins in committed file order): 0093b630 (IO::StreamChild::GetAccessFlags then UTFWin::ImageDrawable::GetImageDrawableFlags, UTFWin wins), 0093c360 (IO::StreamChild::Release then IO::StreamNull::Release, StreamNull wins), 00dde930 (IO::StreamChild::SetSize then Resource::PFRecordRead::SetSize, PFRecordRead wins). classify.py logs each duplicate to stderr on every run; last-wins is deterministic because the export file is committed and read in order.
notes.no_incremental_mode: classify.py has no incremental mode: every run classifies all 58757 functions from the committed exports and upserts the triage table, then rewrites both projections byte-identically for identical inputs. Refresh = rerun.
